args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
==========================

Based on your itinerary for June 10-20, 2024, here's what you'll need to pack:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (multiple sets recommended)
- High SPF sunscreen (reef-safe if possible)
- Hiking gear (comfortable shoes, light backpack, water bottle)
- Casual outfits (lightweight, breathable clothing)
- Camera or smartphone with waterproof case
- Travel documents (ID, passport if needed, hotel confirmations, flight info)

Additional Recommendations:
- Light rain jacket (for potential showers)
- Hat and sunglasses
- Beach towel
- Reusable water bottle
- Snorkeling gear (optional, can be rented at Hanauma Bay)
- Insect repellent
- Beach bag
- Flip flops/sandals
- Evening attire for the Luau (June 16)

Don't forget chargers and adapters for all your electronic devices!
